FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Intervention Risks and BOJ FX Check Weigh on Pair
tldr_points: USDJPY stalls near MA20 amid BOJ FX check and intervention fears.
RSI at 39 signals weakening bullish momentum despite price above MA20.
Key downside target lies at the 156.50–156.30 retracement zone.
